flow.lore: The archive burned for nine days and nine nights, and nothing that was written in it was ever recovered. What remains are the things that were bound to the shelves: smoke given shape, hounds that guard bones, and a warden of stone that never learned the doors were open.
Travellers who camp near the ruins report warm drafts at midnight and the smell of old paper. Those who stay a second night rarely leave.

creature.name: Cinder Wraith

printed.languages: the languages it knew in life

entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
The wraith sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. A creature that touches it for the first time on a turn takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.
The wraith makes two Searing Touch attacks.
Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d8 + 1) fire damage.
The wraith exhales a cloud of smoke in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
The wraith teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
When the wraith is hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

creature.name: Grave Hound
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
The hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.
The hound makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Each creature within 30 feet of the hound that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

creature.name: Vault Warden

printed.ci: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

creature.legendaryIntro: The warden can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The warden regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
entries: The warden is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
The warden has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The warden deals double damage to objects and structures.
The warden makes two Slam attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
The warden makes one Slam attack.
Each creature within 10 feet of the warden must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
